swapTest: 5/5 pass (Alert title+description+action+close, Inline notice description+close, Toast title+description+progress, Progress label+value+track padding, Empty state title+secondaryAction)
anatomy: Alert: C.content card (surface/card, 1px INSIDE material/stroke, radius/card 22, no shadow) led by the notice tile (31:192) sized to the label line: 20 tile r5 in <tone>/default with a 12 glyph in <tone>/fg (neutral text/muted tile + surface/card glyph; important primary/default + primary/fg, no important/default role); title text/fg, body text/muted; action the Plain kind. strong (derived): <tone>/subtle fill + <tone>/border rim, title <tone>/text (neutral material/track).
Inline notice: grey field well (material/track, radius/input 10, no rim) with a 16 tile r4.

Toast: C.float notification card (surface/card, material/stroke rim, radius/card, DROP_SHADOW bound to effect/shadow-overlay + shadow/overlay/y + blur; opaque, never GLASS) with the tone tile; timer a 3px material/track capsule with the tone fill, inset, theme-only timer-gap.
Progress: system bar: material/track capsule 4/6/8 with a primary/default capsule fill (secondary text/muted, status <tone>/default).
Progress circular: ring material/track, arc primary/default (status tone default), round caps.
Skeleton: redacted placeholders in material/track: r4 lines, radius/input blocks (lg radius/card), round avatars.
Skeleton preset: table = inset grouped list (material/fill-strong group r12, border/subtle separators, none under the last row); stats = C.content cards; detail/form = grouped r12 groups.
Empty state: ContentUnavailableView. border on = C.content card (no dashes); bare 32/26 glyph in text/muted (error destructive/default), no tile; prominent capsule + Plain (secondary set to ghost).

sweep.detail: Data display 1: 67 Skeleton + 4 Empty state (Cupertino/Table, Cupertino/Data table)
